verdict.rationale: Crossmint's agent stack is buyer-side: Agent Cards, Agent Wallets and Agent Checkouts let a user's agent pay or buy from any merchant URL. Its merchant-facing headless and embedded checkout targets the merchant's own app or other non-browser environments. No evidence shows a merchant can make products purchasable inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot or similar assistant surfaces, so the agent-buyer capability is adjacent and earns no credit.
